svg.title: 05 Every storage boundary and retained field
svg.desc: Detailed execution call cards in reading order. Each card shows inputs, transformations and persistence. Dashed cards are assumed connections. Branches and alternatives are explicitly labeled. Read the linked Markdown for all field contracts and errors.
svg.text: 05 Every storage boundary and retained field
White outline = implemented function / AWS configuration • Dashed orange = assumed adapter
Read numbered cards in order; follow the explicit branch labels. Full field and failure contracts are in 05-data-ledger.md.

g.text: L1 Raw delivery → parsed wrapper → normalized webhook
MEMORY body Buffer; JSON object; validated delivery
ADD type/sourceEvent; camelCase field mappings
DROP unconsumed metadata; reduce labels and branches
RETURN full normalized webhook only in HTTP response
L2 trackedRequest: projection persisted once
ADD receivedAt; retain deliveryId, webhook_type
KEEP content id/value; repositoryId/repositoryFullName
KEEP issueOrPullRequestNumber and senderId
STORE exactly nine fields; no full webhook or deadline
L3 Scheduler snapshot and EventBridge detail
COPY same nine-field request to two JSON strings
ADD schedule UUID/expression; event provider metadata
STORE schedule input; events are not table updates
NO later journal mutation flows into saved event detail
L4 Assumed adapter: deadline and launch config
ADD receivedAt + 30 min → timeoutAt
ADD fixed region, AMI, type; shared group from env
MEMORY ONLY expanded launch configuration
NO command text, repository checkout or worker credentials
L5 Journal reservation: first nested update
ADD resourceLaunch.deliveryId
ADD resourceLaunch.token = SHA-256(deliveryId)
STORE map on original request; conditional reserve
OMIT config, timeoutAt, status, schedule ID
L6 EC2 allocation and tags
AWS ADDS instance ID, observed state, launch time
TAGS ManagedBy / DeliveryId / LaunchRequestId / TimeoutAt
STORE tags on instance, root volume, network interface
MEMORY ProvisionedResource view includes mapped state
L7 record: second nested update
ADD resourceLaunch.instanceId = resource.resourceId
STORE only this ID; return entire input resource
OMIT status, region, createdAt, updatedAt, timeoutAt
OMIT terminationRequestedAt even when supplied
L8 Delete/sweep → termination → retained identity
AWS accepts termination; eventually removes worker
DATABASE same request + token + instanceId remains
LOG/RESPONSE cleanup arrays; transient status/time views
NO DeleteItem, TTL, job result or terminal-state write
L9 Shared infrastructure and sensitive configuration
RETAIN security group, table, buses, roles, recurring schedule
SECRETS Secrets Manager → Lambda/connection configuration
LOGS request context + authenticated callback body
NO API key/HMAC secret in tracked request or EC2 options
